questions.question: What is OctaKidz?
questions.answer: OctaKidz is a screen-free, activity-based program that develops eight Natural Intelligences and 35+ future-ready skills in children.

questions.question: How does OctaKidz help my child?
questions.answer: It helps children practise critical thinking, creativity, communication, problem-solving and emotional awareness through open-ended activities.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz a tuition program?
questions.answer: No. OctaKidz complements school education by developing thinking and real-world skills beyond marks, subjects and memorisation.

questions.question: Is it a learning program or an assessment?
questions.answer: It is a development program where activities build skills and AI-supported evaluation helps track the child’s emerging strengths and progress.

questions.question: What is higher-order thinking?
questions.answer: It is the ability to analyse, question, connect ideas, solve unfamiliar problems and create original responses instead of only recalling information.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz online or offline?
questions.answer: Children complete the activities offline; screens are used only to upload their work, receive feedback and view progress.

questions.question: Who developed OctaKidz?
questions.answer: OctaKidz was created by a multidisciplinary team of educationalists, pedagogy experts, psychologists and designers.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz an Indian company?
questions.answer: Yes. OctaKidz is a product of Curiosity Quest Private Limited, India.

questions.question: What age group is OctaKidz for?
questions.answer: OctaKidz is primarily designed for children aged 10–14, generally covering Grades 6–9.

questions.question: Can a child outside this age range participate?
questions.answer: Suitability may depend on the child’s grade and comfort with the activities. Please contact our team for personalized guidance.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz suitable for every school board?
questions.answer: Yes. It focuses on transferable skills and can complement CBSE, ICSE, state board, IB and Cambridge education.

questions.question: Does my child need prior knowledge?
questions.answer: No special knowledge is required. Activities begin with familiar situations and encourage children to observe, explore, create and reflect.

questions.question: Is it suitable for children with additional learning needs?
questions.answer: Open-ended activities support different forms of expression, but OctaKidz is not a clinical or special-education intervention.

questions.question: Is the program available in regional languages?
questions.answer: The current program is primarily available in English. Please contact us to check whether language assistance is available.

questions.question: Can children outside India participate?
questions.answer: Digital participation may be possible, but physical-kit delivery depends on the location. Please contact our team to confirm availability.

questions.question: What are the eight Natural Intelligences?
questions.answer: They are Cognitive, Creative, Arithmetic, Artistic, Emotional, Social, Communication and Environmental Intelligence.

questions.question: How are Natural Intelligences different from IQ?
questions.answer: IQ measures a limited range of abilities, while OctaKidz also explores creativity, communication, emotions, social understanding and artistic expression.

questions.question: Does every child have all eight intelligences?
questions.answer: Yes. Every child demonstrates them in different combinations, and these patterns can develop with exposure, practice and experience.

questions.question: Will OctaKidz label my child?
questions.answer: No. It creates an evolving profile based on activity evidence rather than assigning a fixed label or intelligence type.

questions.question: What if my child appears weaker in one intelligence?
questions.answer: It may simply mean that the ability needs more exposure, practice or a different way of expression. It is not treated as a permanent weakness.

questions.question: Can these intelligences improve?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular activities give children opportunities to practise and strengthen different skills and intelligences over time.

questions.question: What skills does OctaKidz develop?
questions.answer: It develops 35+ skills, including critical thinking, observation, creativity, communication, empathy, reasoning and problem-solving.

questions.question: Will it improve my child’s marks?
questions.answer: OctaKidz is not an academic coaching program, but stronger reasoning, curiosity and application skills may support the child’s broader learning.

questions.question: What kind of activities will my child do?
questions.answer: Children draw, design, observe, investigate, solve problems, build ideas, express opinions and reflect on real-world situations.

questions.question: Are these only worksheets?
questions.answer: The activities use sheets and booklets, but go beyond conventional worksheets through investigation, creation, discussion and hands-on exploration.

questions.question: Are the activities screen-free?
questions.answer: Yes. The main learning experience happens offline; the digital platform is used for uploads, feedback and progress tracking.

questions.question: Are there right and wrong answers?
questions.answer: Many activities are open-ended and allow multiple valid answers. Evaluation focuses on the child’s reasoning, originality and expression.

questions.question: How does an activity work?
questions.answer: Every activity follows three stages: pre-learning, a hands-on main activity and post-learning reflection.

questions.question: How long does one activity take?
questions.answer: Most activities take approximately 15–30 minutes, although the time may vary depending on the activity and the child’s exploration.

questions.question: How often should activities be completed?
questions.answer: We recommend approximately two activities per week so the child can remain engaged and develop consistently.

questions.question: What materials are required?
questions.answer: Most activities use simple household materials such as paper, pencils, colours, cardboard and everyday objects.

questions.question: Can my child complete the activities independently?
questions.answer: Yes. Most children can work independently after understanding the instructions, with occasional guidance from a parent or caregiver.

questions.question: What if my child gives an unusual answer?
questions.answer: Unusual ideas are welcome when they are relevant and the child can explain their thinking. Originality is an important part of the experience.

questions.question: What if an activity feels too easy or difficult?
questions.answer: Encourage the child to attempt it in their own way. If the difficulty continues, contact our team for guidance.

questions.question: Do parents need to teach the activities?
questions.answer: No. Parents only need to guide or encourage the child when required; OctaKidz handles the activity framework, evaluation and feedback.

questions.question: How much time must a parent spend?
questions.answer: Most activities require only about 5–10 minutes of light parent involvement.

questions.question: Should I help when my child is stuck?
questions.answer: Help them understand the instruction and ask guiding questions, but avoid giving the final answer so their work reflects their own thinking.

questions.question: Should I correct spelling or drawing?
questions.answer: Allow the child to express ideas naturally. You may ask them to improve readability, but avoid rewriting or improving their response.

questions.question: What if my child loses interest?
questions.answer: Avoid forcing the activity; try another time, connect it to an interest or divide it into smaller steps. Contact us if the concern continues.

questions.question: Can a caregiver supervise instead of a parent?
questions.answer: Yes. Any trusted caregiver can provide light guidance, provided the final response remains the child’s own work.

questions.question: How does the AI evaluate my child’s work?
questions.answer: The system uses activity-specific rubrics to identify indicators such as reasoning, creativity, clarity, relevance and emotional understanding.

questions.question: Does the AI give marks?
questions.answer: No conventional marks or pass/fail judgments are given. The focus is on developmental feedback, strengths and opportunities for improvement.

questions.question: How can AI evaluate open-ended answers?
questions.answer: It compares the response with defined skill indicators rather than searching for one fixed correct answer.

questions.question: Can AI understand handwriting and drawings?
questions.answer: It can evaluate sufficiently clear written and visual responses. Blurry images, missing content or unreadable handwriting may require re-uploading.

questions.question: Can the AI make mistakes?
questions.answer: AI may occasionally misunderstand handwriting, drawings or context. Contact our team if feedback appears inaccurate or inappropriate.

questions.question: Is the AI completely unbiased?
questions.answer: Structured rubrics improve consistency, but no AI system is completely free from errors or bias. Feedback should be viewed as developmental guidance.

questions.question: How long does evaluation take?
questions.answer: Feedback is generated after the activity has been successfully uploaded and processed. Contact support if it remains unavailable.

questions.question: Can I request a human review?
questions.answer: Yes. If you believe the evaluation misunderstood your child’s response, contact our team with the activity and submission details.

questions.question: What does the report show?
questions.answer: Reports show demonstrated intelligences, skills, emerging strengths, areas for improvement and progress across completed activities.

questions.question: How is my child’s progress tracked?
questions.answer: Every completed activity adds evidence to the child’s evolving intelligence and skill profile, helping reveal patterns over time.

questions.question: Does the report compare children?
questions.answer: The primary focus is the child’s individual development rather than ranking them against other children.

questions.question: How many activities are required for a reliable profile?
questions.answer: One activity provides only an initial signal. A more balanced profile develops as the child completes varied activities over time.

questions.question: How often are reports provided?
questions.answer: Reports and progress insights are generated according to the selected plan and number of completed activities.

questions.question: What happens if my child misses activities?
questions.answer: The report will use the completed activity evidence available. Missing activities may reduce the breadth of insights but do not indicate low ability.

questions.question: Can reports be downloaded or shared?
questions.answer: Report availability and sharing options depend on the current platform and plan. Please contact our team for assistance.

questions.question: What does neuroscience-backed mean?
questions.answer: OctaKidz uses principles related to neuroplasticity, active learning, reflection and multisensory engagement to design its activities.

questions.question: Does OctaKidz scan my child’s brain?
questions.answer: No. Brain-scanning or EEG equipment is not part of the regular customer program.

questions.question: Which part of the brain does an activity activate?
questions.answer: Complex activities use interacting brain networks rather than one isolated region. OctaKidz therefore focuses on observable thinking and skill behaviours.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz a medical or psychological assessment?
questions.answer: No. It is an educational development program and cannot diagnose or treat neurological, psychological or learning conditions.

questions.question: Does OctaKidz improve IQ?
questions.answer: OctaKidz does not promise an IQ increase; it provides repeated practice in reasoning, creativity, communication and other future-ready abilities.

questions.question: Does OctaKidz guarantee improvement?
questions.answer: Outcomes vary by child, participation and activity evidence. OctaKidz does not guarantee identical results for every child.

questions.question: What is the OctaKidz Career Map?
questions.answer: It connects patterns in a child’s demonstrated skills, intelligences and interests with possible areas for future exploration.

questions.question: Does it predict my child’s career?
questions.answer: No. It suggests evolving possibilities and should be used as an exploration tool, not a fixed prediction.

questions.question: Is the Career Map based on marks?
questions.answer: It focuses on demonstrated skills, thinking patterns and interests beyond academic marks alone.

questions.question: Can the career suggestions change?
questions.answer: Yes. Suggestions evolve as the child completes more activities, develops skills and discovers new interests.

questions.question: Will my child be pushed toward one career?
questions.answer: No. The Career Map broadens awareness and supports exploration without prescribing one career path.

questions.question: Can we try OctaKidz before subscribing?
questions.answer: Yes. The Starter Pack includes five downloadable activities, an Intelligence and Skill Report and one month of portal access.

questions.question: What does the annual program include?
questions.answer: It includes 75 activities, seven printed booklets, intelligence and skill-based reporting and 12 months of portal access.

questions.question: How much does OctaKidz cost?
questions.answer: The Starter Pack is currently ₹500. Please check the program page for the latest annual-plan pricing and applicable GST.

questions.question: How do I enrol?
questions.answer: Choose your preferred plan on the website, enter the required parent and child information and complete the payment.

questions.question: Can siblings use the same subscription?
questions.answer: Each child should have a separate profile because activities, feedback and progress insights are personalized.

questions.question: Can I upgrade after the trial?
questions.answer: Yes. You can move from the Starter Pack to the annual program for continued activities and progress tracking.

questions.question: When will I receive the booklets?
questions.answer: Printed booklets are usually shipped within three to five working days, with tracking details shared after dispatch.

questions.question: Does the Starter Pack include printed booklets?
questions.answer: No. It includes five downloadable activities that can be printed and completed at home.

questions.question: How do I upload an activity?
questions.answer: Take a clear photograph showing the complete activity sheet and upload it under the corresponding activity in the OctaKidz platform.

questions.question: Why was my submission rejected?
questions.answer: It may be incomplete, blurry, unreadable, incorrectly matched or missing a required page. Follow the displayed instructions and upload it again.

questions.question: Can I replace an incorrect upload?
questions.answer: Please follow the resubmission option shown on the platform or contact support if you cannot replace the activity.

questions.question: Is there a mobile app?
questions.answer: OctaKidz is currently available on Android through Google Play; please check the website for the latest platform availability.

questions.question: How does OctaKidz work in schools?
questions.answer: Students complete hands-on activities while schools receive AI-enabled feedback, participation visibility and monthly progress insights.

questions.question: Does it replace the school curriculum?
questions.answer: No. It complements the curriculum by building real-world thinking, creativity, communication and problem-solving skills.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz aligned with NEP 2020?
questions.answer: Its experiential and competency-based approach aligns with key NEP 2020 directions, but this does not imply government certification.

questions.question: How much timetable space is required?
questions.answer: The implementation can be adapted as an enrichment program, club, home-engagement activity or structured school initiative.

questions.question: Is a school pilot available?
questions.answer: Yes. The website currently offers an introductory two-month program for eligible schools.

questions.question: What happens during implementation?
questions.answer: OctaKidz supports program planning, onboarding, account setup, activity distribution, participation monitoring and progress reporting.

questions.question: How much work is required from teachers?
questions.answer: Teachers mainly support coordination and participation, while OctaKidz manages activities, evaluation and reporting.

questions.question: Are teacher workshops included?
questions.answer: Teacher-enablement workshops can be included based on the school’s selected implementation plan.

questions.question: What reports will the school receive?
questions.answer: Schools can receive student-level insights, completion information, intelligence and skill patterns and broader class-level trends.

questions.question: How is school pricing calculated?
questions.answer: Pricing depends on student count, duration, physical materials, reporting and implementation support. Contact us for a proposal.

questions.question: Does the school need additional technology?
questions.answer: Activities are offline, while digital access is needed for account management, uploads, evaluation and reports.

questions.question: Can OctaKidz integrate with our LMS or ERP?
questions.answer: Integration requirements are reviewed based on the school’s system and implementation scale. Please share your technical requirements with us.

questions.question: Can activities be customized?
questions.answer: Customization may be considered based on grade, student count, regional context and the school’s objectives.

questions.question: How can our school request a demo?
questions.answer: Share your school name, location, grades, approximate student count and preferred contact details with our team.

questions.question: What child information does OctaKidz collect?
questions.answer: It may collect profile information, uploaded activity responses, evaluation results and usage data needed to provide the program.

questions.question: Is my child’s information used to train AI?
questions.answer: Please refer to the Privacy Policy for current information about how uploaded responses and personal data are processed.

questions.question: Who can access my child’s reports?
questions.answer: Access is limited according to the account and program setup. Please refer to the Privacy Policy for more information.

questions.question: Can I request deletion of my child’s data?
questions.answer: Yes. Contact the OctaKidz team to submit a verified account or personal-data deletion request.

questions.question: Is OctaKidz safe for children?
questions.answer: Activities are completed offline, and the platform is primarily used for uploading work, viewing feedback and tracking progress.

questions.question: Can I cancel my order or request a refund?
questions.answer: Eligibility depends on the plan, digital access and whether physical materials have been dispatched.

questions.question: What if my booklet arrives damaged?
questions.answer: Share your order details and clear photographs of the damage with our support team for verification and replacement guidance.

questions.question: I paid but did not receive access. What should I do?
questions.answer: Share your registered contact details, payment date and transaction reference with support. Never share your password, card number or OTP.

questions.question: How can I speak to the OctaKidz team?
questions.answer: Share your name, contact details and question through the Contact Us page, and the appropriate team member will assist you.

questions.question: How can I track my order?
questions.answer: Tracking details are shared after dispatch. Contact support with your order information if you have not received them.

questions.question: Do you provide invoices?
questions.answer: Please contact the team with your order or payment details to request an invoice.
